props.name: variant
props.description: Visual intent (`error` is a deprecated alias of `destructive`).

props.name: action
props.description: Action button: its text, or `true` for "View".

props.name: stack
props.description: Toasts in the stack (up to 3 drawn).

props.name: labels
props.description: UI text; every key is optional and falls back to the English default.

props.name: fill
props.description: In the flow at the full width of the box, instead of pinned to its bottom-right corner.

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: dismiss
props.description: Accessible name of the close button (`dismissible`).
